source:
# Pubid ISO flavor — port of lib/pubid/iso/parser.rb (pubid monorepo).
#
# Scope: the full identifier root — NSB stage prefixes (FprISO, WD/ISO),
# TC documents (ISO/TC 184/SC 4/WG 3 N 123), directives (plain,
# supplement, bundled "DIR 1 + IEC SUP"), JCGM, legacy ISO/R forms
# (including supplements), the three-level supplement chains
# (/Amd/../Cor/../Amd..), and the copublisher identifier spine.
#
# Omitted (next iteration):
# - joint_identifier (ISO 5537|IDF 26) — requires the Idf flavor grammar
#
# Data-driven from tables/ (extracted from the pubid gem): typed stages
# (114 main / 64 supplement), directives stages (5 / 3), TC types (42),
# WG types (21), copublisher organizations (12). The gem's empty-string
# published-stage abbreviation is represented by the absence of
# type_with_stage; duplicate list entries are excluded (identical
# alternatives are a PG lint error).

use idf

grammar PubidIso version "0.3.0" {

  # ---- lexical (pubid/parser/common_parse_rules.rb + ISO override) ----
  digit = %x30-39
  digits = 1*digit
  letter = %x41-5A / %x61-7A
  word_digit = %x30-39 / %x41-5A / %x61-7A
  space = " "
  dash = "-" / "‑" / "‐"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"
  colon = ":"

  century = "19" / "20"
  year_digits = century 2*digit !digit
  month_digits = 2*digit
  day_digits = 2*digit

  # ---- publishers and copublishers ----
  ## The leading organization token. Copublishers follow after a slash,
  ## each captured as :copublisher and grouped under :copublishers.
  publisher = ("ISO" / "IEC") as publisher
  organization = alt from_table "organizations" column "name"
  copublishers_item = slash [space] organization as copublisher
  copublishers = *copublishers_item as copublishers
  prefix_sole_publisher = publisher
  prefix_with_copublishers = prefix_sole_publisher [space] [copublishers]

  # ---- number and parts ----
  number = 1*5digit
  part_sub = dash 1*word_digit
  part_modern = dash [space] 1*word_digit *part_sub
  part_legacy = slash [space] !supplement_type_with_stage 1*word_digit
  part_and_subpart = part_modern / part_legacy
  number_with_part = (number [part_and_subpart]) as number_with_part

  # ---- stage iteration: "ISO 11243.1" ----
  stage_iteration = dot digit as stage_iteration

  # ---- date: ":2005-02", ":--", ":—", legacy dash form ----
  undated = "--" / "—"
  full_date = year_digits [(dash month_digits)] [(dash day_digits)]
  date_core = undated as undated_marker / full_date as date
  date = (colon / dash) [date_core]

  second_part = number_with_part [stage_iteration] [space] [date]

  # ---- typed stages ----
  typed_stage = alt from_table "typed_stages" column "abbr"
  type_with_stage = typed_stage as type_with_stage [digit as stage_iteration space]
  supplement_type_with_stage = alt from_table "typed_stages_supplements" column "abbr"

  # ---- third part: edition, language, all-parts ----
  edition_str = "Edition" / "Ed." / "ED" / "Ed"
  edition = (edition_str [space] [digits]) as edition
  lang_word = 1*letter [","]
  lang_code = %x45 / %x46 / %x41 / %x52 / %x44 / %x53
  lang_item = lang_word / lang_code
  languages = *lang_item as languages
  language = "(" languages ")"
  all_parts = "(all parts)" as all_parts
  third_part_edition = [space] [edition]
  third_part = third_part_edition [language] [space] [all_parts]

  # ---- guide prefix ----
  guide_prefix = "Guide" / "GUIDE"

  # ---- the copublisher identifier form ----
  identifier_copublishers_no_third = [guide_prefix as type_with_stage_fr space] [prefix_with_copublishers] [space] [slash] [type_with_stage] [space] second_part third_part_edition
  identifier_copublishers = identifier_copublishers_no_third third_part

  # ---- JCGM: "JCGM 200:2008(F)" ----
  jcgm_identifier = "JCGM" as publisher space second_part third_part

  # ---- NSB stage prefixes: "FprISO 105-A03", "WD/ISO 10360-5:2000" ----
  nsb_iso_identifier = ("Fpr" as nsb_stage prefix_sole_publisher [space] [copublishers] [space] [type_with_stage] [space] second_part third_part) / ("WD" as nsb_stage slash prefix_sole_publisher [space] [copublishers] [space] [type_with_stage] [space] second_part third_part)

  # ---- TC documents: "ISO/TC 184/SC 4/WG 3 N 123" ----
  tc_type = alt from_table "tc_types" column "name" as tc_type
  wg_type = alt from_table "wg_types" column "name" as wg_type
  sc_type = ("SC/QC" / "SC") as sc_type
  tc_subcommittee_part = (slash sc_type space digits as sc_number slash wg_type space digits as wg_number) / (slash sc_type space digits as sc_number)
  tc_document = prefix_sole_publisher (slash / space) tc_type space digits as tc_number [tc_subcommittee_part] space "N" [space] digits as number [(colon year_digits as year)]

  # ---- legacy ISO/R ----
  iso_r_prefix = "ISO/R" as iso_r_prefix
  iso_r_second_part = number as number_with_part [stage_iteration] [space] [date]
  iso_r_identifier = iso_r_prefix space iso_r_second_part third_part
  iso_r_supplement_separator = slash / ([space] "—" [space]) / (space dash space)
  iso_r_supplement_identifier = (iso_r_prefix space iso_r_second_part) as base iso_r_supplement_separator supplement_type_with_stage [space] second_part third_part

  # ---- supplements (up to three levels) ----
  supplement_identifier_no_third = identifier_copublishers_no_third as base slash supplement_type_with_stage [([space] second_part) / (dot digits as number) / ([space] date)]
  supplement_identifier = supplement_identifier_no_third third_part
  supplement_supplement_identifier = supplement_identifier_no_third as base slash supplement_type_with_stage (([space] second_part third_part) / (dot digits as number third_part))
  supplement_supplement_supplement_identifier = supplement_supplement_identifier as base slash supplement_type_with_stage (([space] second_part third_part) / (dot digits as number third_part))

  # ---- directives: "ISO/IEC DIR 1", "ISO/IEC JTC 1 DIR", supplements,
  # bundled "ISO/IEC DIR 1:2022 + IEC SUP:2022" ----
  directives_publisher_subgroup = "JTC 1" as subgroup
  directives_part_and_subpart = space ("ISO" / "IEC") !slash !(space "SUP")
  directives_number_with_part = (number [directives_part_and_subpart]) as number_with_part
  directives_typed_stage = alt from_table "directives_typed_stages" column "abbr"
  directives_identifier_no_third = prefix_with_copublishers [space] [directives_publisher_subgroup space] directives_typed_stage as type_with_stage [space directives_publisher_subgroup !(space "SUP")] [[space directives_number_with_part] [(colon date)]]
  directives_identifier = directives_identifier_no_third [third_part] [space] [date]
  directives_supplement_typed_stage = alt from_table "directives_supplements_typed_stages" column "abbr"
  directives_supplement_part_no_third = [[space] "--" [space] "Consolidated" space] ("ISO/IEC" / "ISO" / "IEC" / "JTC 1") as publisher (space directives_supplement_typed_stage as type_with_stage) [date]
  directives_supplement_part = directives_supplement_part_no_third [third_part]
  directives_supplement_identifier = directives_identifier_no_third as base [space] directives_supplement_part
  directives_base_document = (directives_identifier_no_third [[third_part] [space]] [[date] [space]]) as base_document
  bundled_supplement = "+ " directives_supplement_part_no_third as supplement
  directives_bundled_identifier = directives_base_document 1*bundled_supplement as supplements
  directives_identifiers = directives_bundled_identifier / directives_supplement_identifier / directives_identifier

  # ---- joint: "ISO 5537|IDF 26" — the IDF grammar is IMPORTED via
  # `use idf` (rules namespaced idf.*, captures unchanged) ----
  joint_identifier = (identifier_copublishers_no_third as base) [space] "|" [space] (idf.identifier as joint_identifier)

  identifier = nsb_iso_identifier / tc_document / directives_identifiers / jcgm_identifier / iso_r_supplement_identifier / iso_r_identifier / supplement_supplement_supplement_identifier / supplement_supplement_identifier / supplement_identifier / joint_identifier / identifier_copublishers
}

entry identifier: identifier

## In-file grammar tests: run at compile time, embedded in the artifact,
## and re-runnable by every consumer (accept / reject / example with
## expected bound captures).
test {
  accept "ISO 8601-1:2019"
  accept "ISO/IEC WD TS 25025"
  accept "Guide ISO/CEI 51:1999"
  accept "ISO/IEC DIR 1:2022 + IEC SUP:2022"
  reject "nonsense"
  example "ISO/IEC WD TS 25025" { publisher: "ISO" }
  example "JCGM 200:2008(F)" { publisher: "JCGM" }
}

# Model-side bindings (PN 4). The pilot binds the flat identity fields;
# the full builder-parity mapping lands with the conformance corpora
# milestone.
preprocess publisher_names {
  table_lookup iso_publishers abbrev -> name
}

bindings identifier {
  publisher -> publisher (string)
  year -> year (integer)
  number -> number (integer)
  publisher -> publisher_name (string) preprocess: publisher_names
}
